items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: Who else was in his band when you played with him? He had Red Happy, you know, he's dead too. Drummer.

ctx.x: He never seen the music for that.

Yeah. He had the music. Yeah, you know, but Chris had the music for it. Mm-hmm. Who else was in his band when you played with him? He had Red Happy, you know, he's dead too. Drummer. Drummer, yeah. I guess you heard of him. I never got to know him. Yeah. Big fella you call Ike. Big Ike Robinson. Ike Robinson is still on Bell Cravo on stage. He was playing with him.
We talked to him a couple months ago.
